mapper.insert:
SELECT seq_product.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO product(productIdx, title, content, price, shippingFee, userIdx, tradeStatus, tradeType, tradePlace, latitude, longitude, regionIdx, productStatus, categoryIdx) VALUES(#{productIdx}, #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{price}, #{shippingFee}, #{userIdx}, #{tradeStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tradeType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tradePlace, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{regionIdx}, #{productStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{categoryIdx, jdbcType=VARCHAR})

SELECT seq_tag.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO tag (tagIdx, tagName) VALUES (#{tagIdx}, #{tagName})
mapper.select: SELECT p.productIdx, p.title, p.content, p.price, p.shippingFee, p.userIdx, p.hitCount, p.likeCount, p.chatCount, p.tradeType, p.tradeStatus, p.tradePlace, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.regionIdx, p.productStatus, p.pullCount, p.lastUpDate, p.createdDate, p.updatedDate, p.categoryIdx, u.nickName FROM product p JOIN users u ON p.userIdx = u.userIdx WHERE p.productIdx = #{productIdx} ORDER BY p.lastUpDate DESC

SELECT * FROM product WHERE userIdx = #{userIdx}
AND (tradeStatus != '임시저장')
AND tradeStatus IN ('판매완료', '판매중', '예약중')
ORDER BY lastUpDate DESC
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM product WHERE userIdx = #{userIdx} AND tradeStatus = '임시저장' ORDER BY updatedDate DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT productIdx, imgOrder, originalName, saveName, imgUrl FROM productImages WHERE productIdx = #{productIdx} ORDER BY imgOrder ASC
SELECT t.tagName FROM productTag p JOIN tag t ON p.tagIdx = t.tagIdx WHERE p.productIdx = #{productIdx}
SELECT tagIdx FROM tag WHERE tagName = #{tagName}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rnum, tb.* FROM ( SELECT p.productIdx, p.title, p.price, p.userIdx, p.tradePlace, p.tradeType, p.tradeStatus, p.productStatus, p.createdDate, p.lastUpDate, p.updatedDate, p.hitCount, p.likeCount, p.chatCount, (SELECT imgUrl FROM productImages WHERE productIdx = p.productIdx AND imgOrder = 1) as imgUrl,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wishList WHERE productIdx = p.productIdx AND userIdx = #{userIdx})
0 as isLiked
FROM product p
ORDER BY p.price ASC
ORDER BY p.price DESC
ORDER BY p.hitCount DESC
ORDER BY p.lastUpDate DESC, p.productIdx DESC
) tb WHERE ROWNUM <= #{end} ) WHERE rnum >= #{start}
SELECT categoryIdx, categoryName FROM category ORDER BY categoryIdx ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET hitCount = hitCount + 1 WHERE productIdx = #{productIdx}

UPDATE product SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, price = #{price}, shippingFee = #{shippingFee}, tradeStatus = #{tradeStatus}, tradeType = #{tradeType}, tradePlace = #{tradePlace}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, productStatus = #{productStatus}, categoryIdx = #{categoryIdx}, updatedDate = SYSDATE WHERE productIdx = #{productIdx}
UPDATE product SET tagIdx = #{tagIdx} WHERE productIdx = #{productIdx}
UPDATE product SET tradeStatus = #{tradeStatus} WHERE productIdx = #{productIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(lastUpDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as lastUpDate FROM product WHERE productIdx = #{productIdx}
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET lastUpDate = SYSDATE WHERE productIdx = #{productIdx}
UPDATE product SET pullCount = pullCount + 1 WHERE productIdx = #{productIdx}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM productImages WHERE productIdx = #{productIdx} AND imgOrder = #{imgOrder}
